mapper.select:
SELECT t1.* FROM (SELECT t.*, CASE WHEN t.plan_date = 'IN' THEN '计划内' WHEN t.plan_date = 'OUT' THEN '计划外' END AS plan_date_n FROM ((SELECT cc.*, c.project_id, c.contract_number, hbm.bp_name, hbm.bp_code, c.currency, fp.guarantor_sum, (SELECT currency_name FROM fnd_currency fc WHERE fc.currency_code = c.currency) currency_name, c.company_id, fe.name manager_name, fou.unit_name, CASE WHEN cc.due_date >= #{dueDateFrom} AND CC.DUE_DATE <= #{dueDateTo} THEN 'IN' ELSE 'OUT' END plan_date FROM con_contract c JOIN hls_bp_master hbm ON hbm.bp_id = c.tenant_id JOIN prj_project fp ON fp.project_id = c.project_id join fnd_employee fe on fp.employee_id = fe.employee_id join fnd_org_unit fou on fou.unit_id = fp.unit_id JOIN (SELECT f.contract_id, f.due_date, f.due_date AS due_date_desc, SUM(f.due_amount) due_amount, SUM(nvl(f.received_amount, 0)) received_amount, SUM(nvl(f.due_amount, 0) - nvl(f.received_amount, 0)) surplus_amount FROM con_contract_cashflow f, con_contract c WHERE c.contract_id = f.contract_id AND f.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' AND f.cf_status = 'RELEASE' AND c.contract_status in ('INCEPT', 'SIGN', 'LOAN') GROUP BY f.contract_id, f.due_date) cc ON cc.contract_id = c.contract_id WHERE c.write_off_able_flag = 'Y' AND c.data_class = 'NORMAL')) t order by t.contract_number, t.due_date desc) t1
1=1
and t1.bp_name LIKE concat('%',concat(#{bpName},'%') )
and t1.project_name LIKE concat('%',concat(#{projectName},'%') )
and t1.contract_number LIKE concat('%',concat(#{contractNumber},'%') )
order by t1.contract_number DESC

SELECT t1.*, fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou JOIN (SELECT p.unit_id, ccc.currency, sum(t.due_amount) due_amount, sum(t.received_amount) received_amount, sum(t.received_amount) / sum(t.due_amount) recovery_rate, sum(t.due_amount) - sum(t.received_amount) surplus_amount FROM con_contract ccc JOIN prj_project p ON p.project_id = ccc.project_id JOIN (SELECT cc.contract_id, sum(ff.due_amount) due_amount, nvl((SELECT SUM(nvl(f.received_amount, 0)) received_amount FROM con_contract_cashflow f WHERE cc.contract_id = f.contract_id AND f.due_date >= #{dueDateFrom} AND f.due_date <=#{dueDateTo} AND f.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' AND f.cf_status = 'RELEASE' GROUP BY f.contract_id), 0) received_amount FROM con_contract_cashflow ff, con_contract cc WHERE cc.contract_id = ff.contract_id AND ff.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' AND ff.cf_status = 'RELEASE' AND cc.contract_status in ('INCEPT', 'SIGN', 'LOAN') GROUP BY cc.contract_id) t ON ccc.contract_id = t.contract_id AND ccc.data_class = 'NORMAL' GROUP BY p.unit_id, ccc.currency) t1 ON t1.unit_id = fou.unit_id
1=1

SELECT fou.unit_id, fou.unit_code, fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou
fou.enabled_flag = 'Y'
and fou.unit_code LIKE concat('%',concat(#{unitCode},'%') )
and fou.unit_name LIKE concat('%',concat(#{unitName},'%') )

select v.* from (select c.contract_id, c.contract_number, c.legal_contract_number, c.contract_name, c.company_id, c.business_type, (select p.project_name from prj_project p where p.project_id =c.project_id) project_number, (select p.project_name from prj_project p where p.project_id =c.project_id) project_name, (select wm_concat(hls.bp_code) from hls_bp_master hls, prj_project_bp ppb where ppb.project_id = c.project_id and ppb.bp_type = 'TENANT' and hls.bp_id = ppb.bp_id) tenant_code, (select wm_concat(hls.bp_name) from hls_bp_master hls, prj_project_bp ppb where ppb.project_id = c.project_id and ppb.bp_type = 'TENANT' and hls.bp_id = ppb.bp_id) tenant_name, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm,prj_project pp where pp.PROJECT_ID=c.PROJECT_ID and pp.MANUFACTURER_ID=hbm.BP_ID) manufacturer_name, c.unit_id, (select fou.unit_name from fnd_org_unit fou where fou.unit_id = c.unit_id) unit_id_n, (select count(1) from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.contract_id = c.contract_id and ccc.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' and cf_status = 'RELEASE' and cf_item = 1) lease_times, (select count(1) from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.contract_id = c.contract_id and ccc.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' and cf_status = 'RELEASE' and write_off_flag = 'FULL') returned_times, (select count(1) from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.contract_id = c.contract_id and ccc.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' and ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE' and ccc.overdue_status = 'Y') overdue_times, (select sum(to_date(sysdate) - to_date(ccc.due_date)) from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.contract_id = c.contract_id and ccc.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' and ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE' and ccc.overdue_status = 'Y') overdue_days, (select nvl(sum(nvl(ccc.due_amount,0) - nvl(ccc.received_amount,0)),0) from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.contract_id = c.contract_id and ccc.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' and ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE' and ccc.overdue_status = 'Y') overdue_amount, (select nvl(sum(nvl(ccc.due_amount,0) - nvl(ccc.received_amount,0)),0) from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.contract_id = c.contract_id and ccc.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' and ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE' --and ccc.overdue_status = 'Y' and ccc.cf_item = 9) overdue_penalty, (select nvl(sum(nvl(ccc.due_amount,0) - nvl(ccc.received_amount,0)),0) from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.contract_id = c.contract_id and cf_direction = 'INFLOW' and cf_status = 'RELEASE' and cf_item = 1) left_rent, (select nvl(sum(nvl(ccc.due_amount,0) - nvl(ccc.received_amount,0)),0) from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.contract_id = c.contract_id and cf_direction = 'INFLOW' and cf_status = 'RELEASE' and cf_item = 3) deposit, (select count(1) from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.contract_id = c.contract_id and ccc.cf_item = 9 and cf_direction = 'INFLOW' and cf_status = 'RELEASE' and write_off_flag != 'FULL') fine_count, c.fine_reduce_status, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'CREDIT.APPROVE_STATUS' and scv.value = c.fine_reduce_status) AS fine_reduce_status_n, (select sum(ccc2.due_amount - ccc2.received_amount) from con_contract_cashflow ccc2 where ccc2.contract_id = c.contract_id and ccc2.cf_item = 1 and ccc2.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' and ccc2.cf_status = 'RELEASE') left_amount, C.HOST_PROJECT_MANAGER, C.ASSIST_PROJECT_MANAGER
from con_contract c) v
1=1 and v.fine_count > 0
and ( V.HOST_PROJECT_MANAGER = #{createdBy} or V.ASSIST_PROJECT_MANAGER = #{createdBy} or #{request.employeeCode} in('ADMIN') OR exists( select 1 from fnd_org_unit a1,fnd_employee a2,fnd_employee_assigns a3,FND_ORG_POSITION a4 where a3.employee_id=a2.employee_id and a3.unit_id=a1.unit_id and a4.position_id=a3.position_id and a4.chief_position_flag='Y' and employee_code=#{request.employeeCode} AND A1.UNIT_ID IN(select b.unit_id from sys_user_allocation a,fnd_employee_assigns b where a.user_id=V.HOST_PROJECT_MANAGER AND a.employee_assign_id=b.employee_assign_id)))
and v.contract_number LIKE concat('%',concat(#{contractNumber},'%'))
and v.tenant_name LIKE concat('%',concat(#{tenantName},'%'))
and v.overdue_times = #{overdueTimes}
and v.contract_id = #{contractId}
and v.legal_contract_number LIKE concat('%',concat(#{legalContractNumber},'%'))

SELECT ( CASE
WHEN pp.business_type IN ( 'T+N_LEASE_FACTORING', 'T+0_LEASE_FACTORING' ) THEN ( SELECT wm_concat( h.bp_name ) FROM prj_project_bp pb, hls_bp_master h WHERE h.bp_id = pb.bp_id AND pb.bp_type = 'ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE' AND pb.project_id = pp.project_id ) WHEN pp.business_type IN ( 'LEASE_WITHOUT_RECOURSE_IN', 'OPERATING_LEASE_WITHOUT_RECOURSE_IN' ) THEN ( SELECT wm_concat( h.bp_name ) FROM prj_project_bp pb, hls_bp_master h WHERE h.bp_id = pb.bp_id AND pb.bp_type = 'ASSET_TRANSFEROR' AND pb.project_id = pp.project_id ) ELSE ( SELECT wm_concat( h.bp_name ) FROM prj_project_bp pb, hls_bp_master h WHERE h.bp_id = pb.bp_id AND pb.bp_type = 'TENANT' AND pb.project_id = pp.project_id ) END ) AS bp_name, pp.CONTRACT_NUMBER, ccc.WRITE_OFF_FLAG, ccc.CF_ITEM, ccc.CF_TYPE, ( SELECT i.description FROM hls_cashflow_item i WHERE i.cf_item = ccc.cf_item AND i.cf_type = ccc.cf_type ) cf_item_n, ccc.TIMES, ( SELECT s.description FROM sys_user s WHERE s.user_id = pp.host_project_manager ) host_project_manager_n
FROM con_contract pp, con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.contract_id = pp.contract_id and ccc.contract_id = #{contractId}
AND ccc.cashflow_id = #{cashFlowId} and ccc.CF_STATUS='RELEASE' and ccc.cf_item in (1,3,4,8) and ccc.WRITE_OFF_FLAG='FULL'
